messages:
Anya: Tiny idea — tiny holiday window contest? decorate your desk/window/zoom background and we do a mini virtual walkaround Friday at 4pm. prizes: best cozy, funniest, most chaotic. :tada: :sparkles:
Marco: love it. can remote folks join? i have zero plants but many holiday mugs. :grin:
Sophie: yes! remote welcome. we can do 2 minute show-and-tell per person. also maybe a cookie swap? send to SF office dropbox or ship to remote folks?
Jon: i can coordinate a small in-office cookie drop: i'll set up a signup form. also can we have a non-cookie option for allergies? (gluten-free / nut-free)
Rachel: count me in for coordinating remote treats. i can compile addresses if people opt in. optional only! :heart:
Anya: quick poll — thread reaction vote: :1st_place_medal: Cozy, :clown_face: Funny, :christmas_tree: Traditional, :robot_face: Futuristic. react to this message to vote.
decor-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Window Walkaround + Cookie Swap" Fri 4:00 PM PST — RSVP by Thu 5PM.
Marco: i voted :1st_place_medal:. also propose a tiny theme: "mini hearth" — fairy lights + one nostalgic item.
Sophie: ooh mini hearth yes. i'll make a tiny paper fireplace.
Jon: signup here (1 min): https://tinyurl.com/rewood-window-swap (just name + in-office vs remote + allergy notes)
Rachel: shipping deadline if remote and want a cookie: Wed EOD for US. i'll DM non-US folks re: local options.
Anya: logistics snippet for in-office dropoff:
```
Dropoff table: lobby conference A
Dropoff window: Fri 9am-2pm
Label: name + "cookie" or "swap - gf" etc
```
Marco: prize suggestion: a goofy trophy (tinsel + mug). i'll bring craft supplies.
Sophie: can we have a tiny photo montage in #random after? i'll make a collage.
Jon: awesome — i'll post the poll results tomorrow and share the signup. excited to see everyone's setups! :cookie:
